instructions.content: Detect existing tool managers and migration constraints before changing anything
Define or update mise.toml tool versions
Add or normalise tasks for common workflows
Install configured tools and validate with mise install && mise doctor
If mise install fails, run mise doctor to diagnose path or plugin issues, then re-run mise install
Keep one canonical mise.toml per project scope
Pin tool versions for reproducible builds
Make tasks deterministic and non-interactive by default
Keep secrets out of committed task definitions
NEVER keep floating tool versions in team repositories; pin exact versions required by CI and teammates
NEVER embed secrets in committed mise.toml; load them from external secret management or local env files
NEVER define tasks that rely on implicit shell state such as a manual cd or prior env exports
NEVER mix multiple tool managers as active authority; migrate ownership per tool and remove overlapping activation
Do not use this skill when the repository intentionally uses another tool manager as the source of truth
Verify active tool versions match the pinned values in mise.toml with mise ls
Pin a tool version with mise use, for example mise use node@22, which updates mise.toml
